title: C Position: Both Hands Together
description: Both hands in C position at once, moving in contrary motion so the same finger numbers play in both hands at the same time - the easiest way to start playing hands together.

arrangements.label: Beginner
arrangements.notes: Mirror-motion quarter notes: when the right hand plays finger 5-4-3-2 the left plays 5-4-3-2 too, so you only have to think of one finger number at a time.
teachingPoints: Both thumbs sit on either side of middle C: RH on C-G above it, LH on F-C below it. The thumbs share middle C, so they never play together here.
Bars 1, 3 and 6: both hands use fingers 5-4-3-2 together; say the finger numbers aloud while you play.
Bars 5 and 7: RH goes up 1-2-3-4 while LH goes down 2-3-4-5 - the hands still move in mirror directions.
Practise each bar hands separately once, then together very slowly, before moving on.
